name: Environment Maker
summary: Five connected cinematic environments from one world: empty movie-set backgrounds for your characters. Upload a character to match its look, or pick one of 30 styles (anime, 2D, 3D, photoreal and more), or just name a place, and get copy-ready JSON image prompts.
use_when: You want backgrounds, environments, locations or movie sets for your characters; you want a whole world built around a character image; you want a place in anime, 2D, 3D or photoreal style; you want more locations from the same world; or you want a prompt that puts your character into one of the sets.
produces: Five standalone JSON text-to-image prompts per request: one direct match plus four related locations from the same world, each with camera angle, framing, lens, lighting and a full prompt text. Empty by default, with extras on request. Also a style menu of 30 looks, location ideas, a chain prompt that ties the five sets to your first render, and a prompt that places your character into a set.
